title: Annual review.
bodyText: The commissioner shall periodically review and evaluate the motor vehicle insurance program described in this article, including an annual review of the premium rates, benefit payments and insurers' loss experience.
bodyHtml: §431:10C-216  Annual review.  The commissioner shall periodically review and evaluate the motor vehicle insurance program described in this article, including an annual review of the premium rates, benefit payments and insurers' loss experience. [L 1987, c 347, pt of §2]
